_comment: Measured unit costs and wall clocks for projections (docs/PLAN-2.md Stage 1.3). Every row carries its provenance: the result files it was computed from, the sample size, the date, and the cost regime (E27: opus verdict costs roughly doubled platform-side between 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-15; rows measured before that carry regime 'pre-E27'). tools/handoff.py and tools/route.py read this file; a project's own routing ledger overrides a row once it has enough entries (routing_priors.json: ledger_overrides_after). Wall clocks are for benchmark-sized tasks (a small repository, one change) and are a starting point, not a property of a consumer's tasks. No number here is typed in by hand: the aggregation script is quoted in each row's 'method'.

worker-sonnet-low.provenance: every per-run row at worker-sonnet-low across test/results/*benchmark*.md (T1 to T11, raw handover, no brief), 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-13; min and max are per-task means (T5 low, T10 high)
worker-sonnet-low.method: regex over the per-run detail tables '| <cell> | <run> | yes|no | USD <cost> | <wall> |', pooled, mean

worker-sonnet-low+b0-brief.provenance: test/results/2026-09-14-benchmark-282981f-tasks-T10+T11+T9-brief-b0-brief.md and ...-tasks-T10-brief-b0-brief.md (Stage 9.8, D47); the same cell with .claude/B0_BRIEF.md prepended, which about doubles cost and triples wall clock

worker-sonnet-medium.provenance: T4 and T10 search-phase runs only (the staircase climbs only after the floor fails, so this is conditional on floor failure and on hard tasks)
worker-sonnet-medium.method: as above; too few runs to carry a range

worker-sonnet-high.provenance: T4 and T10 search-phase runs only, conditional on floor failure

worker-sonnet-xhigh.provenance: T4 and T10 confirmation runs, conditional on floor failure; T10 alone: 0.5616, 280 s, n=12

worker-opus-high.provenance: T10 confirmation, test/results/2026-09-11-benchmark-af94deb-tasks-T10+T11+T9.md (D42), the only task any cell above the floor was ever confirmed on; range from D47's restatement

worker-opus-max.provenance: never run on any benchmark task (docs/FRONTIERS.md: the frontier row is an unmeasured escalation mechanism); a projection that reaches this cell must say it is unmeasured

worker-fable-max.provenance: never run on any benchmark task; one fable-xhigh run of 103k tokens exists (docs/FRONTIERS.md) and is not a cost measurement

controller.provenance: test/results/2026-09-15-fleet-T10-batch2-checkpoint.jsonl, the six completed runs of the batch D58 recorded (Controller cost from budget.jsonl; instantiation is the worker-sonnet-low call that applies REPORT.md, D55); the three runs that died on budget spent about 2.8 each and are not in the mean
controller.method: python over the checkpoint's result records: mean of controller.cost, controller.wall_clock, instantiate.cost, instantiate.wall_clock

verdict.provenance: E27 (docs/FINDINGS.md): four single verdicts 2026-09-15 at 0.223 to 0.248, and the nine-run after-measurement at USD 4.06 per 18-fixture run; pre-E27 figure from D45 (USD 0.129 per verdict, 2026-09-14); wall clock from the E27 diagnostic calls (7 to 12 s)
verdict.two_stage_provenance: D40, test/results/2026-09-11-routing-*-d65b476-two-stage-3axis-summary*.md; the assessment-only schema-forced call with the table out of context

session.provenance: docs/COST.md, the fixed load of a stage session, 2026-09-15; chars/4, not a provider count
